S0779.reason: An easement by necessity arises when land becomes landlocked through severance, and the cousin's refusal of a reasonable alternative may not defeat the necessity claim since the original severance created it.

S0783.reason: General principles are those common to the major legal systems of the world, not limited to 'civilized' nations.
